name: @zudocs/cost-check
description: The Zudocs monthly cost check: one Lambda in us-east-1 that runs the same Cost Explorer query as `npm run cost:report`, files cost/YYYY-MM.json in the trail bucket and puts the Zudocs/Cost expectedMonthlyUsd metric. Invoked by an EventBridge Scheduler schedule on the third of the month (and by hand).
